verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents top-k vector search, building vector indexes with PQ, RaBitQ and SQ quantization, and an option to force an exhaustive flat scan for exact results. That option implies the default indexed path is approximate. Results expose `_distance` and support distance-range thresholds, and binary vectors use hamming distance. Configurable metrics are only partly shown: hamming is the only metric named, and no snippet shows choosing a metric per index or query. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of selectable metrics (e.g., L2/cosine/dot) and how to set them, ANN recall/latency tuning details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of ANN search quality.
